title: Telegram Desktop session and cache (Snap)
whyItMatters: The Snap build keeps the live Telegram session and media cache under the user's snap folder, where a native-only check will not find it.
source: Snap keeps per-app data under ~/snap/<name>/common; Telegram Desktop's snap is telegram-desktop: https://snapcraft.io/telegram-desktop
notes: common is a real folder shared across revisions, so the path stays stable after updates. Settings saved outside the sandbox may live in ~/snap/telegram-desktop/current/.config instead.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Telegram Desktop, use the export option in the advanced settings if you want a copy of your chats: the tdata session is not readable.
cleanup.signOut: In Telegram Desktop, open Settings, then the menu in the top right corner, and choose Log out, so this computer stops using the account.
steps: Quit Telegram Desktop from its tray icon.
Uninstall the Telegram snap from the App Center or with the Snap Store app.
Move the folder named in the plan to the Trash and empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Ends the session and deletes the local media cache and message database in the snap folder. Chats stay in your Telegram account.
cleanup.source: Telegram, How do I log out? (Telegram FAQ): https://telegram.org/faq#q-how-do-i-log-out
